labels.ACL: a partial or complete anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) tear
labels.MCL: a medial collateral ligament (MCL) sprain or tear
labels.Medial OA: medial tibiofemoral osteoarthritis with high-grade cartilage loss
labels.Lateral OA: lateral tibiofemoral osteoarthritis with high-grade cartilage loss
labels.PF OA: patellofemoral osteoarthritis with high-grade cartilage loss
labels.Effusion: a moderate or large knee joint effusion
